title: Syncify
tagline: ⚡ NFT MUSIC INSIGHTS BASED ON DATA - No more tedious searches and hours spent on analysis! Our data-driven recommendations help you make a killing with music NFTs. Dashboard that combines Spinamp API with Zora ZDK
description:
Today I want to present the Syncify app. It's a dashboard that combines Spinamp api with Zora ZDK. We need this killer combination to show analytics on music nft. For example, on Spinamp we can get already processed tracks with a good UX, and on Zora we get NFT financial activity

I believe this information, helps to make better choices when investing in NFT! Now we can see the top music tracks that sold with the best price on zora. And we can also look at just interesting new NFT music. More metrics, analytics and charts for analysis will be added in the future. We may also add a recommendation system depending on the investor's portfolio.

We also have a page in the app where the user can learn more about how NFT content is stored and why reliability is achieved. For example, he can upload his audio and get the CID hash and see the link to the file
how_its_made:
This project uses Spinamp API with Zora ZDK. Also, we have a page with NFT Storage, that show how you can upload audio content. It was difficult to combine the data from Spinamp with the data from Zora. I spent quite a few hours in GraphQL explorer

Spinamp has very good UX and DX. It gives a lot of data, but there are no processed tracks for Zora. Zora ZDK has support only in Ethereum network, but I would like to use Polygon. NFT Storage is as good as ever. It's easy to set up in a couple of steps. Fast uploading and downloading!
